import sys, json, time, importlib.util, random, subprocess, math
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import stress
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m','/workspace/submission/main.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
for cnt in (1, 1000, 1000000):
    doc, cl = stress.build(K=32, nrib=2000, nq=512, qlen=64, nprior=0, ndecl=0, count=cnt)
    doc = json.loads(json.dumps(doc))
    ixps, rib, priors, declared, order, queries = m._parse(doc)
    agg={}
    for path,count in rib:
        n=m._normalize(path,ixps)
        if len(n)<2 or len(set(n))!=len(n): continue
        agg[tuple(n)]=agg.get(tuple(n),0)+count
    al, rounds, surv = m._peel(list(agg.items()))
    core=sorted({m._canon(p[i],p[i+1]) for p,_c in surv for i in range(len(p)-1)})
    fa={}
    for p,c in surv: fa[p]=fa.get(p,0)+c
    vi={e:i for i,e in enumerate(core)}
    occ=m._occurrences(list(fa.items()), vi, len(core))
    M=[sum(occ[e].values()) for e in range(len(core))]
    scopes=[]
    for e in range(len(core)):
        ctx=set()
        for (lk,rk) in occ[e]:
            if lk[0] in (1,2): ctx.add(lk[1])
            if rk[0] in (1,2): ctx.add(rk[1])
        scopes.append(tuple(sorted(ctx|{e})))
    ov=[vi[tuple(x)] for x in order]
    m._check_width(scopes, ov, len(core))
    factors=m._tables(occ, scopes, len(core))
    t=time.time()
    z, marg = m._eliminate(factors, ov)
    print('count max %8d: core=%d maxM=%d Z digits=%d  elim=%.2fs' % (
        cnt, len(core), max(M), len(str(z)), time.time()-t))
EOF
